title: Runtime Lifecycle: Activation and Draining
summary: Runtimes move through a strict state machine to ensure safe transitions between active and retired code.
why: Allows for 'zero-downtime' upgrades where the old version continues to serve existing requests while the new version takes over new requests.
invariants: Active -> Draining: The generation no longer accepts new requests but remains warm for in-flight ones.
Draining -> Retired: All pinned sessions have released their leases.
Failed quiesce aborts activation: If the previous active generation fails to quiesce, the new candidate is not published.
